title: Rory and the Star-Lit Meadow
verses:
The moon floated high over canyons of stone,
As Psittaco chirped from a nest in the bark.
Young Rory walked softly, no longer alone,
To gather his friends in the velvety dark.

Wise Tilly stepped out from a shaded blue glade,
While Benny sat down by the slumbering stream.
They weaved through the ferns in the quieting shade,
To follow the glow of a star-little dream.

High over the canopy Nia flew low,
While Ricky lay down with his chin on his paw.
She chirped as she led them with silvery glow,
To coziest mosses that anyone saw.

Sweet Psittaco nested inside Nia's wing,
As Rory curled up on a bed made of moss.
The night-breeze was whispering softly to sing,
While shadows danced gently and drifted across.

Big Benny breathed in with a comforting sigh,
And Tilly tucked in with her head on a fern.
The stars lit the sky as the night glided by,
With nothing to fear and no lesson to learn.

Now all of the dinosaurs slumber at last,
So safe in their cozy green home in the deep.
The worries and troubles have all fully passed,
So close your sweet eyes for a beautiful sleep.
